A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for the Serbian Home.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; SERBIAN HOME. +]

[+$900,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the Serbian Home on the National Registry of Historic Sites in South St. Paul to repair and preserve the cultural and historic landmark for the Serbian community. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for the Serbian Home.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SERBIAN HOME.

$900,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the Serbian Home on the National Registry of Historic Sites in South St. Paul to repair and preserve the cultural and historic landmark for the Serbian community.
additions: $900,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the Serbian Home on the National Registry of Historic Sites in South St. Paul to repair and preserve the cultural and historic landmark for the Serbian community.
